description: The resource lists annual residential vacancy rates by municipality for non-subsidised rental buildings containing at least three units. Native time-span metadata covers 1988–2021. CSV, XLSX, JSON and XML descriptors and an exploration interface describe alternate representations of the same municipal series. The scope excludes an inferred census of all dwellings, subsidised accommodation and buildings below the stated size threshold. Survey sample sizes, uncertainty estimates, exact returned years and within-municipality geography are not established. The measure concerns use of the residential building stock. No present vacancy rate or projection is inferred from this historical catalogue snapshot. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Government of Alberta; Jobs, Economy and Northern Development. Licence: Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and current file access are unverified.
